detail.request: Let readers save articles to read later. I want a "Saved" page listing what they have saved, a save/unsave control they can drop onto an article, and the article list should show which ones are already saved.

operations.intent: Logic component exposing inputs [Do, articleId, action] and outputs [Success, Failure, isSaved, savedArticles] to save/unsave an article for the current user (e.g. persisted list keyed by user) and to query whether a given articleId is currently saved, plus fetch the full list of saved articles.

A toggleable save/unsave control with inputs [articleId, isSaved] and output [Toggled] that visually reflects saved state and can be dropped onto an article; on click it calls Logic Components/Manage Saved Articles to toggle the save state.

New page listing all articles the current user has saved, fetched via Logic Components/Manage Saved Articles, each rendered with a Save Button so users can unsave from this list; requires user to be logged in (use Logic Components/Is user logged in?).

Add a Save Button instance (passing articleId/articleObjectId and isSaved) so readers can save/unsave the article directly from the article view, wired to Logic Components/Manage Saved Articles for saved-state lookup and toggling.
Add navigation/routing entry point to the new Pages/Saved page (e.g. a nav link or menu item to route 'Saved') so readers can reach their saved-articles list from the main app shell.

outcome.error: The agent could not produce a valid component within its budget.

detail.request: Add author profiles: a page for one author with their photo, bio and the articles they wrote, and make the author name on an article link through to it.

operations.intent: Given an author slug/id input (in: Slug, Do), query Contentful GraphQL for the author's name, photo, bio, and the list of articles they wrote, exposing outputs (Success, Failure, author) with author fields (name, photo, bio, articles) for use by the Author Profile page.

New page with input pm-slug identifying the author; uses Get Author From Slug to fetch and display the author's photo, bio, and name, plus a list of the articles they wrote, each linking to /Pages/Article via its pm-slug.

Make the author name text clickable, navigating to the new /Pages/Author Profile route with the author's slug as pm-slug; requires the author identifier to be available or passed in alongside existing inputs (author, articleId, etc).
Register the route for /Pages/Author Profile (e.g. /author/:slug) mapping the pm-slug parameter, alongside the existing /Pages/Article route, so author profile links resolve correctly.
